r.경제 체제: Economy opening up · gold, gas, cotton, remittances
r.주식시장 시가총액: $23.7 billion, 16% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.생활 물가 수준: 28% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Car parts 35%, Machinery, computers 18%, Cars 9%, Electronics, electrical equipment 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Pulp 31%, Soybeans and oilseeds 12%, Fertilizer 10%, T-shirts 9% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A presidential system that since 2016 has opened its economy and improved relations with its neighbors.

t.why: A 'double-landlocked' country: reaching the sea means crossing two borders. Gold, gas and cotton are its main resources.
t.rel: A double-landlocked country in the heart of Central Asia: reaching the sea means crossing two borders. Since 2016 it has greatly improved relations with its neighbors by settling border and water issues.
t.korea: Many Koryo-saram live there, and many Uzbeks work in Korea.
t.know: Uzbekistan is one of only two double-landlocked countries in the world.
t.etext: It sells gold, natural gas, cotton and copper. Since 2016, opening markets and freeing the exchange rate have brought more foreign investment. Remittances from people working in Russia are large too.
